judgements.reasoning: Both blind pairs' findings were walked and verified: the proposal pair's thirteen and six, and the system pair's four, whose one regression (a working-tree diff writing the index) the verification pass caught and the last walk fixed with a test that fails on the old code. accepted.claim: A path removed from the index with git rm --cached while its unchanged file stays on disk still gets a commit printed, which fails with nothing to commit.
accepted.why: The external pass's empty-commit finding was fixed for every other cancelling case; this one reads as both staged-deleted and untracked, and the step-failure row shows the recovery. Named in the requirement.

accepted.claim: Until a release carrying orbit pr commit is installed, the installed orbit answers the commit step with unknown command in this repository.
accepted.why: The fresh pass found it; CLAUDE.md names node bin/orbit.js pr commit as the stand-in, and the step reports a non-zero exit in one line and runs nothing.

accepted.claim: The default-branch row is untested when the remote's HEAD ref is absent.
accepted.why: Read from refs/remotes/<remote>/HEAD only, with no gh; a default branch renamed to the attachment's name since propose is not caught there. Named in the requirement; select refuses the collision at propose.
